This is an optional, voluntarily initiated, **public** project issue, not a
contract, reservation, sale, quote, or payment request. Do not post PII, names or
contact details of private people, secrets, credentials, payment details, or
client files. Use only fictional or already-public minimal examples.

The original preview is authored, validated, and reviewed automatically with AI;
no human QA is claimed. Posting does not create a commitment from either party.
Scope, license, price, timeline, and any lawful fiat collection method require
qualification and agreement before any commitment. Do not send money here.
There is no continuous monitoring or response-time promise.

Fill only what is useful; every field below is optional.

## Use case or bug

What join, aggregation, pipeline, or dashboard behavior are you exploring?
For a bug, describe expected and observed behavior with a small fictional example.

## Schema

Which files, fields, keys, or types matter? Do not attach private source data.

## Row volume

What approximate row volume or date coverage would be useful?

## Acceptance criteria

What measurable checks would define the intended result? This is discussion,
not an accepted delivery specification.

## Optional budget

An optional indicative fiat amount or range, without payment or account details.
It is not an agreed price, quote, reservation, or request to pay.
